duplicate_gate.selected_construct: Lymphangioleiomyomatosis in a young woman with diffuse thin-walled cysts and renal angiomyolipoma
duplicate_gate.precision_note: A prior probe falsely overmatched because the abbreviation LAM is a common substring; the accepted precision probe removed the short token and returned zero hits.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Reproductive-age woman with recurrent pneumothorax, diffuse thin-walled cysts and renal angiomyolipoma reconstructs LAM.
adversarial_second_pass.BHD_attack: Birt-Hogg-Dubé can cause cysts/pneumothorax but has FLCN-associated fibrofolliculomas and renal neoplasms rather than the classic angiomyolipoma/LAM pattern.
adversarial_second_pass.PLCH_attack: Pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis is smoking-associated with irregular upper-lobe nodules/cysts.
adversarial_second_pass.emphysema_attack: Centrilobular emphysema lacks true thin cyst walls and the angiomyolipoma association.
adversarial_second_pass.LIP_attack: LIP usually accompanies autoimmune/immunodeficiency disease with ground-glass/nodular interstitial findings.
